purpose: Define each concrete deployment execution as an explicit identity over one exact plan revision with per-target actions, state and results.

topics.name: Deployment Execution
topics.purpose: Define each concrete deployment execution as an explicit identity over one exact plan revision with per-target actions, state and results.

semantics.identity_rule: Each deployment execution has a distinct identity.
semantics.plan_rule: Execution references exact deployment plan revision.
semantics.actor_rule: Requester/automation identity and authorization evidence are explicit.
semantics.result_rule: Deployment result is separate from service health/readiness.
semantics.retry_rule: Retries create explicit attempts and respect idempotency.
semantics.authority_rule: Accepted release does not itself authorize deployment.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.

hard_gates.condition: deployment execution identity reused as plan identity
